d:
Bihar ke shiksha mantri mithilesh tivari ne midiya se batchit karte hue pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure, karmachariyon ke vetan ko lekar pradhanmantri dvara korporet jagat ko die gae sandesh aur rajy ke shikshakon ki mangon par apni pratikriya di hai.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
